description: This file defines a React component 'AvailabilitySettingsPlatformWrapper' that manages schedule availability settings, including fetching schedule data, handling updates and deletions, and rendering the 'AvailabilitySettings' component with appropriate props and callbacks.

classes.name: AvailabilitySettingsPlatformWrapper
classes.description: A React forwardRef component that wraps schedule availability settings, managing data fetching, updates, deletions, and rendering.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a schedule by ID, invoking the deleteSchedule mutation.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating a schedule with given ID and form data, optionally calling onBeforeUpdate callback.
